paper_name: 69_W.C. Moshier, G.D. Davis, J.S. Ahearn, H.F. Hough, J Electrochem Soc, 134 (1987) 2677-2684.pdf

observations.association_notes: Sputter-deposited films; deaerated 0.1 N KCl, pH 8.
observations.result_note: Approximate discrete breakdown-potential reading, determined by rapid current-density increase during potentiodynamic polarization. The paper associates Eb with visible pit formation; the smooth fitted line is not an additional observation. Closely spaced concentrations are separate plotted specimens, not replicates inferred from the fit.
